# Tuya TV Viewer v0.4.0: MQTT diagnostics and copyable logs

Experimental Android TV APK. Tuya Smart login, IPC configuration check, TCP relay, and MQTT 3.1.1 authentication over TLS; no SDP offer is sent and no video is opened. Copy Log redacts names and identifiers. This build does not play video. Same application ID as v0.2/v0.3, but varying debug signatures may require uninstalling the previous build. No credentials, sessions, or user keys are published.
